messages.body:
Hi Morgan — Robin (TPM). Quick status on BigCorp (Casey) escalation, since you flagged the QBR earlier:

Casey escalated their ETL failing against the events endpoint since Friday's hotfix. Kai has confirmed the hotfix path touches the same events table that V24-11 (missing workspace_id index) is targeting — high likelihood this is the same root cause as the known v2.4 migration regression, not a separate BigCorp-only issue.

Current state:
- Jordan is pulling BigCorp's ticket history + request IDs and scanning other accounts for similar ETL/events failures.
- Kai has offered a 15-min look once we have a request ID; V24-11 work continues either way.
- I'm inside the 2h customer-response SLA and will get a status back to Casey today with either a fix ETA or a workaround for the QBR.

No action needed from you right now — just keeping you in the loop given the QBR sensitivity and the three audit-log-gated deals. I'll flag if customer-facing comms (V24-4/V24-8) need to move.

Thanks for the heads-up, Robin. Casey's QBR is this week so the sooner we have a fix ETA or workaround the better — I'd rather give them something concrete before the meeting than a vague 'we're investigating.' Please loop me in the moment you have a response ready for Casey, and flag immediately if V24-11 or the audit-log scope looks like it's slipping — three deals are riding on that feature shipping on time.

Morgan — quick update on Casey/BigCorp: Kai confirmed the Friday events-endpoint hotfix likely touches the same table as V24-11 (workspace_id index), so the symptoms may share a root cause. Kai has eyes on it; I'll send you a concrete ETA/workaround as soon as he's back with the diff confirmation. AUDIT-3/5 are unblocked (retention=90d signed off; UTC-at-API confirmed) and Priya is moving — three deals should not be at risk on the audit-log side. Will flag immediately if anything slips.

Good to hear AUDIT-3/5 are unblocked — that's the most important thing for the three deals. On Casey: please send me the ETA/workaround the moment Kai confirms, even if it's a rough estimate. I need something concrete to give them before the QBR, not after.

Morgan — Casey/BigCorp update: Kai has confirmed the Friday events-endpoint issue almost certainly shares root cause with V24-11 (missing index on events.workspace_id). Fix is in flight as part of v2.4 (P0, due pre-deploy). Workaround for Casey ahead of QBR: queries scoped tightly by workspace_id + short time windows avoid the timeout path; we expect full resolution at v2.4 deploy Fri EOD. I'll send you a written line you can paste to Casey once Kai confirms the diff — targeting today.

Perfect — the workaround (tight workspace_id + short time-window queries) is exactly what I need to hold Casey over until Friday's deploy. Send me that paste-ready line the moment Kai confirms the diff; I'll get it to Casey before the QBR. And thanks for keeping AUDIT-3/5 on track — that's what protects the three deals.
